request: Analyze GSE315228 for PMID 41683811 (Molecular Indicators of Isometric Exercise Efficacy in Early Rehabilitation of Older Adults After Total Hip Arthroplasty.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (Oxford Nanopore PromethION cDNA), rectus femoris of the operated leg (S4.3.p1, S4.4.p2)
final.subjects: 8 women aged 73-77 after THA; control = standard isometric-exercise (IE) protocol n=4, experimental = additional/longer IEs n=4, sequential non-randomized allocation (S4.1.p2)
final.repeated_measure_unit: patient (biopsies at d0, d1, d12 from the same patient; S4.3.p1, S4.6.p2)
final.technical_replicates: up to three sequencing runs per biopsy, all included in the paper's analysis (FIG3 legend)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of the additional isometric-exercise rehabilitation on the rectus femoris transcriptome: the paper reads it from within-arm 12d-vs-preop changes (exp12vs0 vs ctr12vs0); the exercise-attributable contrast is the arm difference in that change (interaction), which the paper does not test directly
planned_contrasts: 1vs0: d1 vs d0, both arms pooled, paired on patient (S4.6.p2; paper 593 up / 1986 down)
ctr12vs0: control d12 vs d0 (S2.2.1.p3; paper 546 up / 190 down)
exp12vs0: experimental d12 vs d0 (S2.2.1.p3, S3.p7; paper 3989 up / 290 down)
final.paper_method: featureCounts counts, DESeq2 1.38.3 Wald test, BH FDR <= 0.05 (S4.5.p1, S4.8.p1); design formula and pairing not stated; technical runs included as samples (FIG3)
final.enrichment: GSEA with GSEApy on MSigDB sets (S4.7.p1)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Study map from S4.1-S4.8 and FIG3/FIG4. Both arms exercise; the arms differ in IE dose and content (S4.1.p14). Time contrasts within an arm mix surgery recovery with rehabilitation, so only the between-arm difference in change isolates the added exercise.

checks: 72 GEO samples = 8 patients x 3 time points x 3 technical runs; treatment control/experiment 4 patients each, matching S4.1.p2
organism Homo sapiens, female, rectus femoris, PromethION, matching S4.4
data_processing repeats the paper's pipeline (minimap2, featureCounts, DESeq2)

ownership.reasoning: Series, sample design and processing all match the paper.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix and metadata are the prep_collapse_techreps.py outputs: technical runs of one biopsy were summed (barcode parsed from description, patient and time from characteristics, cross-checked against titles). Exact match of the 24 biopsy IDs. Columns subject (P1..P8), grp (ctr/exp), time (d0/d1/d12). Three failed runs (<1000 reads: barcode01 P1_d0 rep1, barcode54 P8_d12 rep3, barcode67 P4_d1 rep1) were left out of the sums.

matrix.reasoning: integer_fraction 1.0, max 283922, median 0; GEO data_processing: 'csv file includes raw counts for each sample' from featureCounts. Matches the paper's DESeq2 input.

design.subject: subject

final.analysis_type: repeated measures, 2 arms x 3 time points, patient as blocking unit
final.formula: ~ subject + time within arm subsets; interaction on per-patient d12-d0 differences ~ grp

design.reasoning: Paper's planned contrasts are within-patient time changes (S4.6.p2): pooled d1 vs d0, and d12 vs d0 within each arm. These estimate surgery plus rehabilitation over time in each arm, not the added-exercise effect; the paper infers the exercise effect by comparing the two arms' DEG lists (S2.2.1.p4). The direct test of that inference is the grp x time interaction (exp d12-d0 minus ctr d12-d0), run as an exploratory addition. Arms are non-randomized (S4.1.p2), so between-arm contrasts are associational with respect to allocation. n=4 patients per arm.

covariance.reasoning: Each patient contributes d0, d1 and d12 biopsies (S4.3.p1) and the paper compares them 'relative to preoperative samples from the same patients' (S4.6.p2). Patient is nested in arm, so it cannot be a covariate in a model that also estimates arm; the interaction is therefore fitted on within-patient differences.

final.formula: ~ subject + time within each arm subset (both arms for d1 vs d0)

interaction (exploratory) uses limma on per-patient log2(CPM+1) d12-d0 differences, ~ grp, because a nested-subject DESeq2 interaction design is not available in the runner
one unpaired joint DESeq2 model ~ cell over all 24 biopsies lists every comparison as exploratory
